exp3-en/report-s3-s4-autonomous.md (internal stage report; S4 calibration artifact included under freeze/.../calibration-e3.json)
raw_dependent_tests: exp3-en/test_e3.py and exp3-en/run_tests_e3.py (replaced by data/raw-free test_prereg_e3_offline.py)
